## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive
where: HiveRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
private readonly items = new Map<string, Hive>();
=====SOURCE-END=====
graph:
- class HiveRepository (node 22ea3eb4c082b330): layer infrastructure, component persistence, fan-out 0, fan-in 12
- <- CALLS Method BeekeepingService.findHive
- <- CALLS Method BeekeepingService.listHives
- <- CALLS Method BeekeepingService.listHivesNeedingTreatment
- <- CALLS Method BeekeepingService.registerHive
- <- CALLS Method ReportService.quarterlyReport
- <- CALLS Method ScaleService.linkScale
- <- CALLS Method ScaleService.recordReading
- <- CALLS Method TreatmentService.findHive

### B
concept: Hive Scale
where: ScaleService (uses), src/business/scaleService.ts, component business
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
return this.scales.save({ serialNumber, hiveId, ownerId, phoneNumber });
=====SOURCE-END=====
graph:
- class ScaleService (node f7e458262ae72ac4): layer domain, component business, fan-out 11, fan-in 0
- -> CALLS Method HiveRepository.findById
- -> CALLS Method InspectionRepository.findByHive
- -> CALLS Method ScaleRepository.findBySerial
- -> CALLS Method ScaleRepository.save
- -> CALLS Method WeightReadingRepository.add
- -> CALLS Method WeightReadingRepository.findBySerialBetween
- -> CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS Class HiveRepository
- -> CONSTRUCTOR_INJECTS Class InspectionRepository

response.rationale: A and B are different concepts. A Hive is the bee colony and its box, kept in HiveRepository as `Map<string, Hive>`. A Hive Scale is a separate weighing device. It has its own identity (serialNumber), its own repository (ScaleRepository) and its own owner and phone data. It points to a hive only through a foreign key: `this.scales.save({ serialNumber, hiveId, ownerId, phoneNumber })`. In the graph, ScaleService calls HiveRepository.findById separately from ScaleRepository.save. So the scale is linked to the hive, not another name for it.
